subject: Geopolitics
title: Gaza and Competing Narratives
description: A fast breakdown of Gaza and Competing Narratives for builders.

hook.text: Two feeds. One shows Israeli victims. The other shows Palestinian casualties. Same platform, different realities.

buildup.text: In the Israel-Palestine conflict, both sides deploy media strategies to frame events.

discovery.text: Social media algorithms create filter bubbles.

twist.text: Independent verification is nearly impossible during active conflict.

climax.text: Competing narratives in conflict make truth the first casualty.

punchline.text: Same war. Two stories. No shared truth.

quiz.question: How do filter bubbles affect conflict coverage?
options: They ensure equal coverage of all perspectives
Audiences see only one side, hardening existing views
They only affect print media, not social media
